cases.title: Search Meal by Keyword
cases.description: Verify that entering a valid keyword in the search input and clicking the search button fetches matching meals, displays them in the meals container, updates the result heading, and clears the search input.

cases.title: Search Meal No Results Found
cases.description: Verify that searching for a non-existent keyword clears the meals container, displays 'No results found. Try another keyword!' in the result heading, and clears the search input field.

cases.title: Random Button Click
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'Random' button fetches a random meal, displays it in the single meal container, and clears the meals container and result heading. Rapid successive clicks should display the latest fetched meal.

cases.title: Click Meal Element for Details and Scroll
cases.description: Verify that clicking a meal element within the meals container uses its data-mealid attribute to fetch details, displays them in the single meal container, and smoothly scrolls the container into view.

cases.title: Page Load Random Meal Fetch Success and Failure
cases.description: Verify that on page load, a random meal is automatically fetched and displayed with details while result and meals containers are cleared. If the API fails, display 'Failed to fetch a random meal.'

cases.title: Submit Search Form with Empty or Whitespace Input
cases.description: Verify that submitting the search form with an empty string or whitespace triggers a random meal to be displayed in the single meal container, clears the result heading, and clears the input field.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases completely cover the requirements, are distinct, have clear expected outcomes, and contain no blockers.
All requirements and cases are consistent, well-defined, and fully testable without any blockers.

analysis.analysis: e2edev_bench_27-R-1: Testable behaviors include searching by keyword, updating result heading, handling no results, and clicking meals for details. Normal paths: valid keyword returns matching meals. Abnormal paths: empty keyword triggers random meal, no matching meals clears container and shows 'No results found'. Boundaries: empty input. e2edev_bench_27-R-2: Testable behaviors include fetching a random meal on button click, clearing meals container and result heading, and handling rapid successive clicks. Normal paths: single click fetches random meal. Abnormal paths: rapid clicks display the latest meal. e2edev_bench_27-R-3: Testable behaviors include clicking meal elements to retrieve details via data-mealid attribute, displaying details in single meal container, and smooth scrolling. Normal paths: click on 'meal-info' class triggers fetch and scroll. e2edev_bench_27-R-4: Testable behaviors include automatic fetch of random meal on page load, rendering meal details, and clearing result heading and meals container. Normal paths: successful API fetch. Abnormal paths: API failure shows 'Failed to fetch a random meal.'. e2edev_bench_27-R-5: Testable behaviors include submitting search form with empty or whitespace input. Normal paths: triggers random meal display and clears result heading. e2edev_bench_27-R-10: Testable behaviors include clearing search input field after submission under all scenarios (valid search, empty search, no results found). Normal and abnormal paths: input is cleared immediately upon form submission.
